title: Progressionism
description: Aims to add evolutionary mechanics and aspects of real-life. Still in development!
body:
# Important news

## **The Mod is now compatible with 26.2! Newer versions will not work with 1.21.11!**

# About progressionism
Progressionism is a mod that aims to add evolutionary mechanics and reallife aspects to the game. Including tin and upcoming bronze and new tree punching mechanics. Plus so much more!

![The Mod Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9ecbc17d31a12db3ada7987c9a9a95da8929f662_0.webp)

# What is in the mod?
At the moment Progressionism only has a few tin blocks and items but it aims to add so much more. Bronze, steel, flint tools, currency, steel and other real world things. Tin blocks require a stone pickaxe to be mined. Blocks range from dropping 1 to 4 items.

![The Mod Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4308695bad66f8727056fdb8b29fa02fb41e48e9.png)

# Contribute to the mod!
Please help fill out the wiki about the mod. As the developer I don't have a lot of time to be making it. That's why I need your help. Links are above.

# Test the mod!
The mod is currently in Alpha, and it would really help if everybody reported a bug to the issues page. Links are above.
